fileNamePattern.fieldDescription: Regex pattern matching characters that are NOT allowed in file names. Leave blank to use the default pattern which blocks: < > : " / \ | ? * and control characters.
fileNamePattern.name: ./fileNamePattern

maxTotalSize.fieldDescription: Optional. When set, a file that would push the total of all files over this size isn't added. Same MB as the Maximum file size (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes). Leave blank to show the total without checking it.
maxTotalSize.name: ./maxTotalSize

messagesHeading.text: Messages (leave blank for the default in the form's language)

fileNamePatternMessage.fieldDescription: Shown when a file name has characters that aren't allowed. Placeholders: {fileName}, {size}. French default: « {fileName} » ({size}) n'a pas été ajouté. Renommez le fichier en utilisant seulement les caractères permis, puis téléversez-le de nouveau.
fileNamePatternMessage.name: ./fileNamePatternMessage
fileNamePatternMessage.emptyText: "{fileName}" ({size}) wasn't added. Rename the file using only allowed characters, then upload it again.

msgFileTooLarge.fieldDescription: Shown when a file is larger than the Maximum file size. Placeholders: {fileName}, {size}, {maxSize}. French default: « {fileName} » ({size}) n'a pas été ajouté. Choisissez un fichier de {maxSize} ou moins.
msgFileTooLarge.name: ./msgFileTooLarge
msgFileTooLarge.emptyText: "{fileName}" ({size}) wasn't added. Choose a file that is {maxSize} or smaller.

msgDuplicateFile.fieldDescription: Shown when a file has the same name as one already attached (ignoring case). Placeholders: {fileName}, {size}. French default: « {fileName} » ({size}) n'a pas été ajouté. Un fichier du même nom est déjà joint.
msgDuplicateFile.name: ./msgDuplicateFile
msgDuplicateFile.emptyText: "{fileName}" ({size}) wasn't added. A file with the same name is already attached.

msgTotalTooLarge.fieldDescription: Shown when a file would push the total over the Maximum total size. Placeholders: {fileName}, {size}, {maxTotal}. French default: « {fileName} » ({size}) n'a pas été ajouté. Retirez un fichier ou choisissez-en un plus petit pour que le total soit de {maxTotal} ou moins.
msgTotalTooLarge.name: ./msgTotalTooLarge
msgTotalTooLarge.emptyText: "{fileName}" ({size}) wasn't added. Remove a file or choose a smaller one so the total is {maxTotal} or less.

msgTotal.fieldDescription: Shown under the list of files. Placeholder: {total}. French default: Total : {total}
msgTotal.name: ./msgTotal

showAlertMessage.fieldDescription: When enabled, displays a browser alert when a file name fails validation. Disable if you prefer to suppress the alert and handle feedback through other means.
showAlertMessage.name: ./showAlertMessage
